scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix Geoportal-aburra install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run start:routes" "npm --prefix Geoportal-aburra run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run start:routes" "npm --prefix Geoportal-aburra run preview"
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix Geoportal-aburra run test
